jei.simplecrucibles.info.soul_lava_bucke: Scoop a soul lava source: an iron bucket takes it but breaks when the soul lava is poured; an Enderite bucket never breaks. By default, soul lava is found in 0.5% of the Nether's lava springs and in the lava well of 10% of Nether fortress entrances. By default, a soul lava bucket burns 10 times as long as lava. These values are configurable; fuel changes require a restart. Above it a crucible gets extreme heat.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.copper_bucket_f: Scoop water or lava with a copper bucket. Pouring water only leaves a flowing block that runs off, never a source. Pouring lava breaks the copper bucket. A copper bucket cannot take soul lava.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.enderite_bucket: Scoop water or lava with an Enderite bucket: it holds two buckets of the same fluid. Use only scoops until it is full, then use pours one bucket; sneak + use pours one bucket at any fill. It comes back after pouring and never breaks.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.ceramic_bucket_: Scoop water or lava with a ceramic bucket; scooping does not wear it. Each pour wears it one stage, and the fourth pour breaks it. Burnt as furnace fuel, the ceramic lava bucket burns up with its lava.

A worn ceramic bucket moves one stage on each pour - intact, chipped, cracked, brittle - and keeps what it holds. The brittle bucket breaks on its fourth pour. Worn buckets cannot be repaired; fire a new one from clay.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.copper_bucket: Takes water and lava, never soul lava. Weathers while carried in the hotbar or off hand, or lying in the world or in an item frame (not in chests); fully oxidized it scoops nothing until scraped back. Honeycomb waxes it (in the off hand while holding the bucket, or used on an item frame): a waxed bucket does not weather. Filling a waxed bucket wears the wax, so it weathers at half pace until waxed again. An axe scrapes off the wax or one stage. Breaks when pouring lava.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.enderite_bucket: Takes water, lava, soul lava and milk (from cows, goats and mooshrooms), two buckets of one fluid, and never breaks. Pours soul lava into a reinforced cauldron, which then heats a crucible extremely.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.ceramic_bucket: Shape 3 clay balls like a bucket into a raw ceramic bucket and fire it in a furnace or crucible. The ceramic bucket takes water and lava (no soul lava, no milk), wears one stage per pour, and breaks after four pours; scooping does not wear it.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.enderite_crucib: With SimpleBuilding, hold a Netherite sledgehammer and Enderite nuggets in the off hand on a Netherite crucible and keep right-clicking: 12 strikes, every third strikes one nugget in (4 in all). A Netherite barrel takes two nuggets and twice the strikes of a furnace upgrade. The contents stay. 30 slots with double stacks, 8 times as fast.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.1.title: Simple Crucibles
simplecrucibles.guide.page.1: Iron, Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite crucibles that cook every slot at once without fuel, barrels that dock onto them, the reinforced cauldron and village field kitchens.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.2.title: Crucibles
simplecrucibles.guide.page.2: A cooking station without fuel that cooks every slot at once, heated by the block below.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.3.title: Village field kitchens
simplecrucibles.guide.page.3: Villages of all five types can have a small field kitchen: an iron crucible on an unlit campfire with cooked food, a barrel of raw meat and a seat.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.4.title: Reinforced cauldron
simplecrucibles.guide.page.4: A cauldron for water, lava, powder snow and soul lava; lava in it heats a crucible like a lava source.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.5.title: Soul lava
simplecrucibles.guide.page.5: A rare Nether fluid and the only extreme heat source: it flows short and slow, is never replaced, and gives Seelenbrand (soul burn). Split stage 5b: was SimpleBuilding's, old worlds migrate.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.6.title: Copper, Enderite and ceramic buckets
simplecrucibles.guide.page.6: Buckets for the crucible's fluids: the iron bucket breaks on soul lava, the Enderite bucket holds two buckets and never breaks, copper oxidizes, ceramic wears. Split stage 5b:
simplecrucibles.guide.page.7.title: Copper, Enderite and ceramic buckets
simplecrucibles.guide.page.8.title: First pickup tips
simplecrucibles.guide.page.8: The first time you pick up a machine or tool whose use is not obvious, one short tip shows in the action bar - once per player and world.
